full_text:
Article 6 (Promotion of Railroad Freight Transportation)
Pursuant to Article 16 (2) of the Act, the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport may provide administrative and financial support to a person intending to transport by railroad vehicle any freight falling under a subparagraph of Article 16 (1) of the Act with respect to the following:
1. Installation of logistics facilities under Article 2 (1) 4 (a) of the Framework Act on Logistics Policies;
2. Research and development to improve the efficiency of railroad freight transportation.
